transitions.label: Session start: return to Karawa
transitions.evidence: u0006-u0007 describe the sun sinking and explicitly give May 23; the year is anchored by session YAML. u0975-u0979 contain a mistaken morning reference immediately corrected by the DM to the same arrival evening.

transitions.label: Intervening day in Karawa
transitions.evidence: The montage introduced at u1428-u1430 covers the available day before the ritual; u1483 looks back at sleeping the previous night, and u1539 calls the ritual the following evening. Assign May 24 to the day’s errands; their precise hours are unstated. The driftglobe discussion is retrospective, not another overnight transition.

transitions.label: Following evening: return for the ritual
transitions.evidence: u1539-u1540 explicitly say the following evening, when the party returns to the temple. u1601 confirms evening light. u2599-u2600 confirm the ritual and battle finish while it is still evening after roughly thirty minutes; u2601-u2604 discuss real-world session timing, not an in-world midnight.

transitions.label: After sunset: mourning and funeral
transitions.evidence: u2747 describes the cloisters in darkness because the sun has set; u2756-u2758 have the party settle for the evening and the funeral, leaving next steps for morning. The source does not advance into that morning.
